name: Wikidata Enrichment
description: Structured data enrichment for place details

dataSources.purpose: Enrich place details with structured facts (founding date, population, architect, etc.), description, Wikipedia link, and lead image
dataSources.dataSent: Wikidata entity ID (QID from OSM tag), language preference
dataSources.dataReceived: Entity claims, descriptions, Wikipedia sitelinks, referenced entity labels

dataSources.purpose: Fetch metadata for the Wikidata main image (P18 claim)
dataSources.dataReceived: Thumbnail URL, artist, license, capture date, coordinates
